title: National Security Act passed weeks after Roswell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of National Security Act passed weeks after Roswell, about 1947 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: believe the National Security Act was September 1947 and Roswell was July of 1947.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that the National Security Act, the 1947 US law that reorganised the country's military and intelligence agencies, was passed in September 1947. That was only weeks after Roswell, the July 1947 report of a crashed object near Roswell, New Mexico. He raises the timing because, if the two were connected, it would mean the government's new secrecy machinery was shaped partly by the crash.
